info.name: Talentry - API Testing - JobTrack
info.description:
API test collection for the JobTrack job application tracker (Node.js, Express, MongoDB, JWT).

How to run: select the "JobTrack - Local" environment, start the API, run `npm run seed` once (creates the admin), set `adminPassword` in the environment, then run the whole collection with the Collection Runner (folders run in order because later folders reuse data created earlier).

Folder order follows data dependencies: Authentication, POST, GET, PUT & PATCH, Negative & Error Handling, DELETE (destructive, runs last).
